versions.content: In case PDU header option is enabled ( SoAdPduHeaderEna ble is TRUE ) for a socket connection, SoAd shall convert the message into a PDU within SoAd_RxIndication() according to the following: (1) assemble the PDU Header into a SoAd receive buffer if it is fragmented in multiple TCP segments (2) extract the PDU Header from the received message (3) select the related socket route according to the received PDU Header ID ( SoAdRxPduHeaderId ); if no socket route can be found, simply discard the PDU and raise the runtime error SOAD_E_INV_PDUHEADER_ID . (4) use the length field of the PDU Header to identify the length of the actual PDU and the start of the next PDU to proceed with (2) until the end of the message is reached. If the remainder is smaller than a PDU Header or the indicated length within the header SoAd shall stop processi ng and ignore the rest of the message.
